en: • Intermediate cars were added in 1971 due to the popularity of the 12200 series.
• By combining with A set, 4-car and 6-car formations can be reproduced.
• The roof parts can also be used as an intermediate model for the 12400 series with different cooler types.
・Compatible with power unit 3 ・Compatible with running trolley T ・Contains 2 cars
